messages.admin.comments.deleteConfirm: Deleting cannot be undone. Are you sure?
messages.admin.comments.note: Comments from signed-in users go live immediately; anonymous ones always land in this queue. An open comment section without review turns into a spam dump within months — search engines list unmanaged UGC spam as a site-level demotion reason.
messages.admin.comments.title: Comment review
messages.admin.edit.archiveConfirm: Archiving removes it from listings, search and the sitemap, but the URL keeps working. Continue?
messages.admin.edit.bodyPlace: Say what this post solves in the first three sentences — the summary is taken from here.
messages.admin.edit.canonicalHint: Setting this points search engines at the original and marks this copy noindex.
messages.admin.edit.deleteConfirm: Deleting cannot be undone and leaves a dead link. Are you sure?
messages.admin.edit.indexable: Let search engines index this page
messages.admin.edit.langHint: Decides which language listing it appears in, and the page's html lang.
messages.admin.edit.slugHint: Non-Latin titles fall back to a random short code; type a slug here if the URL matters.
messages.admin.edit.sourceHint: Record it honestly. An unchecked share of AI-generated content is a site-wide risk.
messages.admin.edit.summaryPlace: Leave empty to take it from the opening of the body
messages.admin.edit.tagsHint: Reuse existing tags instead of inventing synonyms.
messages.admin.edit.title: Title
messages.admin.edit.titlePlace: Be specific, and put the keywords early
messages.admin.edit.transHint: The id of the same content in another language. Both sides then emit hreflang for each other. Leave empty if this stands alone.
messages.admin.media.deleteConfirm: Posts embedding this image will show a broken image. Are you sure?
messages.admin.media.deleted: Deleted. Posts embedding it will show a broken image.
messages.admin.media.emptyHint: Upload one, or let an AI client use upload_media.
messages.admin.media.hint: JPEG / PNG / GIF / WebP, up to {0} MB each. Uploads are converted to WebP and scaled down to the size limit — if the conversion comes out larger, the original is kept, and animated GIFs are left alone. The type is read from the file's bytes, so renaming the extension changes nothing. Re-uploading identical content reuses the existing file.
messages.admin.media.title: Media
messages.admin.media.tooBig: Upload failed: file too large, or the form was malformed
messages.admin.posts.emptyHint: Change the filter, or write a new one.
messages.admin.posts.featuredOver: {0} posts featured; the home page shows only the {1} most recently pinned.
messages.admin.posts.title: Posts
messages.admin.profile.emailNote: {0} is your sign-in identity and cannot be changed here.
messages.admin.profile.name: Display name
messages.admin.profile.pwDone: Password changed. All other sessions have been signed out.
messages.admin.profile.pwMismatch: The two new passwords do not match
messages.admin.profile.pwNote: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else. The usual reason to change it is suspecting a breach, and leaving old sessions alive would defeat the point.
messages.admin.profile.pwRelogin: Password changed. Please sign in again.
messages.admin.profile.slugHint: Currently {0}. Changing it breaks the old address.
messages.admin.profile.slugPlace: Leave empty to derive from the name
messages.admin.profile.uiLangHint: Affects the admin interface only. A post's own language is set in the editor.
messages.admin.quota.note: The daily cap is an architectural constraint: AI clients can only write drafts, and publishing always goes through here.
messages.admin.tokens.daysHint: 0 means forever. Setting an expiry is recommended.
messages.admin.tokens.intro: For AI clients connecting over MCP. With {0} they can publish directly; without it they can only write drafts and you publish from the admin.
messages.admin.tokens.name: Name
messages.admin.tokens.nameHint: Say which machine and client it is for, so you can revoke the right one later.
messages.admin.tokens.publishWarn: Lets the AI put posts live on its own. The daily publish cap still applies.
messages.admin.tokens.reveal: The new token, shown only once
messages.admin.tokens.revealHint: Only its SHA-256 is stored. Copy it now — you cannot see it again.
messages.admin.tokens.revokeConfirm: Clients using it stop working immediately. Are you sure?
messages.admin.tokens.title: API tokens
messages.comment.bodyPlace: Plain text only — links are not rendered as clickable.
messages.comment.namePlace: Leave empty to post as Anonymous
messages.comment.queued: Comment submitted. It will appear once reviewed.
messages.comment.title: Comments
messages.comment.tooFast: Too many comments (max 3 per 10 minutes). Try again later.
messages.err.commentsOff: Comments are closed on this site
messages.err.notFound: There is nothing at this address.
messages.err.tagEmpty: No posts under this tag yet
messages.flash.archived: Archived: gone from listings and search, but the URL still works
messages.home.emptyHint: Sign in to the admin and start writing.
messages.login.title: Sign in
messages.login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again later.
messages.post.archivedNote: This post is archived: it no longer appears in listings or search, and its content may be out of date. The original link keeps working.
messages.post.syndicated: First published on {0}; this is a copy.
messages.search.placeholder: Words in the title or body
messages.search.title: Search
messages.scope.media: Upload images to the media library
messages.admin.edit.transEmpty: No posts in another language yet. Write one first, then come back and link it here.
messages.admin.edit.publishAtHint: Goes live automatically at this time. Leave empty for no schedule. Until then it stays a draft — absent from listings, search, the sitemap and the feed.
messages.admin.site.title: Site settings
messages.admin.site.gscHint: In Search Console pick the HTML tag method and paste the content value here. Once verified, submit {0} over there.
messages.admin.site.bingHint: In Bing Webmaster Tools pick the HTML Meta tag method and paste the msvalidate.01 value. Importing from Search Console works too, and then you can skip this.
messages.admin.site.ga4Hint: Looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX. This is the only setting on this page with a runtime cost: filling it in loads Google's third-party script and opens script-src up to googletagmanager.com. Leave it empty and the site makes no third-party requests at all. Admin pages never load it either way.
messages.admin.site.indexnowHint: With a key set, every publish, edit, unpublish and delete notifies Bing, Yandex, Seznam and Naver instead of waiting for them to crawl. Google does not support IndexNow — that side still relies on the sitemap.
messages.admin.site.keyFileOff: Once a key is set, the key file is served at {0}
messages.admin.site.ga4Warn: CSP opened up to load a third-party script
messages.scope.mediaDelete: Delete files from the media library
messages.scope.site: Change site integrations and author profile
messages.admin.tokens.moderateWarn: Comments are written by anyone on the internet and the AI reads them into its context — grant with care
messages.admin.tokens.packHint: Contains the MCP config, an OpenAPI spec and the operating rules. Import it into Claude or a custom GPT and the AI can run the whole site. The token is a placeholder you paste yourself — a file with a live credential sitting in your downloads folder costs more than one extra paste.
messages.comment.queueFull: Comments are paused: the moderation queue is full. They reopen once it is cleared.
messages.admin.cats.name: Name
messages.admin.cats.slugPlace: Derived from the name if empty
messages.admin.cats.sortHint: Lower numbers come first; ties fall back to the name. Navigation order is yours to decide, not the alphabet's.
messages.admin.cats.emptyHint: A site covering one topic doesn't need them — tags are enough.
messages.admin.cats.deleteConfirm: Posts in this category become uncategorised. Not a single one is deleted. Continue?
messages.admin.edit.categoryHint: Decides which section this post appears under. A post belongs to at most one.
messages.admin.site.commentsHint: Turned off, the form disappears from posts, the submit endpoint returns 404, and the admin tab is hidden. Existing comments stay in the database and come back when you turn it on again. The -comments=false flag is a harder switch: with it set, ticking this box changes nothing.
messages.admin.site.name: Site name
messages.admin.site.nameHint: Shown in the header, the browser tab and share cards.
messages.admin.site.descHint: The one-line introduction on the home page, also used as the meta description and in share cards. Keep it under about 155 characters — search results cut off the rest.
messages.admin.cats.descHint: The section page's meta description. Section pages have no body text to summarise, so without this they fall back to the site description.
messages.admin.cats.orderHint: Drag the handle at the start of a row, then save.
messages.admin.site.langHint: Only ticked languages are offered publicly: they appear in the switcher, in hreflang and in the sitemap. Unticked prefixes return 404 — leaving an empty listing page crawlable is worse than not offering the language at all. The default language cannot be turned off. The admin's own interface language is unaffected.
messages.admin.site.langNotReady: Less than 80% translated, not selectable yet
messages.admin.site.copyHint: Stored per language. The <title> and meta description go straight into search results, so an English page carrying a Chinese title is wasted work. Leave a language empty and it falls back to the default one.
messages.admin.site.fromCatalog: This one comes from your -lang-dir catalogue; what you type here has no effect.
messages.admin.edit.coverHint: Shown on list cards, at the top of the post, and as the large image when the post is shared (og:image). Landscape works best — around 1200×630.
messages.admin.edit.coverAltHint: One line describing what is in the picture. Screen readers read this out, and it is what shows when the image fails to load.
messages.admin.edit.dropHint: You can also drop an image straight into the body, or paste one.
messages.admin.media.pickEmpty: Nothing in the library yet — upload one first.
messages.admin.cats.slugShared: The slug is shared across languages: /c/essays and /en/c/essays are the same section. Changing it breaks existing links.
